scope: Selected public UKMTO notices, manually reviewed 23 November 2026. Not a live feed, not exhaustive, and may be superseded. Incident times are those in UKMTO reports.

events.title: UKMTO advisory — reported tanker and military-forces encounter
events.summary: UKMTO reported an incident involving a tanker and military forces. Investigations were ongoing at the time of publication.

events.title: UKMTO warning — tanker reportedly struck in engine room
events.summary: UKMTO reported a projectile striking a tanker transiting outbound; no casualties were reported at the time.

events.title: UKMTO warning — tanker reportedly struck at stern
events.summary: UKMTO reported that a projectile hit a tanker during an outbound transit; the reported environmental impact remained unconfirmed.

events.title: UKMTO warning — tanker reportedly struck; fire reported
events.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker hit during an outbound transit, with an onboard fire reported by its company security officer.

events.title: UKMTO warning — armed skiff reportedly approached bulk carrier
events.summary: A ship's master reported an armed approach and exchange of warning shots. No crew injuries or vessel damage were reported.
